Subject: Request: Permission to publish Aurora AI case study & logo

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. We drafted a short customer story highlighting how Aurora AI uses Redwood Inference to reduce inference cost and simplify deployment.

Attached is a one-page draft (Aurora_case_study_draft_v2.pdf) and a suggested quote: "Redwood reduced our per-inference cost by ~40% while improving 99th-percentile latency." Please let us know if that quote is accurate and whether we can: 

- Use Aurora AI"s name and logo on the case study landing page and PDF
- Include the one-line quote attributed to "Aurora AI / Elena Ruiz"

If you can share the preferred logo files and any brand guidelines we should follow, we will make the edits and send the final permission form for signature.

Happy to hop on a quick call if that is easier.

Thanks,

+1 (415) 555-0148
